categories.main_business_segments: Kingcan Holdings Limited operates primarily in the metal packaging industry, specializing in the production of three-piece tinplate cans and two-piece aluminum cans. The company also extends its business into beverage and food filling and packaging contract manufacturing, providing integrated one-stop production services. Its product applications cover beverages, food, agricultural and aquatic products, dairy, coffee, tea, health foods, pet foods, and chemical pressure cans.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including high-speed production lines for tinplate can printing and manufacturing, powder electrostatic coating for corrosion resistance, automated detection devices for quality control, and energy-efficient equipment such as environmental drying ovens and RTO thermal oxidizers. It emphasizes product innovation with over 60 can specifications and continuous R&D in automation, process optimization, and new product development, including patented technologies like motor-free U-shaped turntables and automated sorting mechanisms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kingcan serves major customers in the fast-moving consumer goods sector, including well-known beverage and food companies in China and Taiwan such as Wanglaoji, Xiamen Yinlu Group, Hainan Coconut Palm Group, Shanghai Want Want Group, Qingdao Beer, Snow Beer, Nestlé Qingdao, Taiwan Beer, Coca-Cola Taiwan, and King Car Foods. The company also targets export markets in South Asia, the Middle East, North America, and aims to expand in these regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with production bases in Fujian, Shandong, Guangdong, Hubei, Henan, Shaanxi, and Taiwan (Hsinchu). It also has subsidiaries and investments registered in the Cayman Islands, British Virgin Islands, Samoa, and Hong Kong. Its sales are predominantly focused on the Chinese mainland and Taiwan domestic markets, with growing export activities to South Asia, the Middle East, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kingcan operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the metal packaging supply chain. It manufactures metal packaging materials (upstream raw materials sourced from suppliers) and extends into downstream beverage and food filling and packaging contract manufacturing, offering integrated production solutions from packaging material manufacturing to filling and packaging services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes product diversification, process integration, and capacity optimization across its production bases. It focuses on R&D for lightweight and environmentally friendly packaging, automation, and quality control technologies. Strategic initiatives include expanding two-piece aluminum can production, developing niche products, deepening strategic alliances with customers and suppliers, and advancing ESG and green factory certifications. Planned R&D projects include automation of can lines, mechanical arm rotation, and process improvements in stamping and drying.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of metal packaging products including tinplate cans, aluminum cans, printed packaging, and can lids. Additional revenue comes from contract manufacturing services for beverage and food filling. The company also earns from processing fees related to metal packaging and filling services. Sales are conducted primarily on a product sales basis to large branded customers and through long-term supply contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kingcan is one of the leading metal packaging suppliers in China, ranking among the top five tinplate can manufacturers and top ten in profitability within the Chinese metal packaging industry. It competes with other major players such as COFCO Packaging, Shanghai Baosteel, Orijin, Shengxing, and Jiamei. The company leverages its scale, product diversity, and integrated service offerings to maintain competitive advantages in a highly competitive and fragmented market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kingcan reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$8.95 billion, reflecting an 8.4% increase from the prior year. Despite revenue growth, the company recorded a net loss attributable to the parent company of NT$54 million due to product mix challenges and increased management expenses related to new plant operations. The company maintains a solid asset base of over NT$13.4 billion and equity of NT$6 billion, with ongoing capital expenditures to expand aluminum can production capacity and filling operations. The workforce comprises over 1,300 employees with steady growth and investment in training.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kingcan emphasizes durable, high-quality, and environmentally sustainable metal packaging products that meet international standards for food safety and recyclability. Its product range includes over 60 can types with advanced printing and coating technologies that enhance product appeal and value. The company offers integrated one-stop solutions from metal packaging manufacturing to beverage and food filling, enabling customers to focus on marketing and distribution. Its scale, technological innovation, and strategic regional production layout provide cost advantages and reliable supply, differentiating it from competitors.
